difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a bijective continuous map from a quasi-compact space to a Hausdorff space is a homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 3497-3502, label lemma-bijective-map). The chain is short but complete; registered at the lower level for that reason, since every step is a named general fact applied once. H2.
